critical_code_review_comments: videos_api.py generate_question_id counterpart (in questions_api.py): topic-code derivation uses first-letter-of-each-word of first two topic words. Topic 'Electricity' -> 'E' (single word, 1-char code), while 'Forces & Motion' -> 'FM'. This produces IDs like 'P-E-001' vs 'P-EL-001' inconsistently. The current sample seed hard-codes 'EL' via seed_questions but generate_question_id would produce 'P-E-###' at runtime for new questions with topic 'Electricity'. Consider a stable topic->code mapping or a first-two-letters-of-topic fallback so admin-created IDs match the seed convention.

videos_api.py generate_question_id is only used for /questions/admin/create; videos_api create_video does NOT auto-generate a video_id — videos rely on Mongo ObjectId only. If the intent is for videos to also have a human-friendly identifier, add one.

videos_api.py media upload accepts any file type/size with no validation — no extension whitelist, no max size check. Malicious uploads (e.g., .html/.js) served from /api/uploads/... could be an XSS vector since StaticFiles serves with permissive content-types. Recommend: (a) extension whitelist [jpg,jpeg,png,webp,gif,pdf,mp4,webm], (b) max size ~50MB, (c) force Content-Disposition: attachment for non-image/video types.

videos_api.py media upload sanitizes only the extension; `folder` form param and `file.filename` are not sanitized — path traversal is possible if folder='..' or filename contains slashes. Current mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True) would create the traversed directory. Recommend: allow-list regex ^[a-z0-9_-]+$ for folder and use pathlib basename only.

questions_api.generate_question_id uses count_documents({subject}) + 1 as the sequence number — this is race-prone under concurrent creates (two admins create at the same time both get the same N) and also shifts if any question is deleted (a new create can collide with an existing ID). Recommend: MongoDB counters collection with $inc or aggregate max of question_id numeric suffix + 1.

videos_api.py has no index on ('board','subject','chapter') even though /videos/chapter/{board}/{subject}/{chapter} is the hottest public read path. Add db.videos.create_index([('board',1),('subject',1),('chapter',1),('order',1)]).

MediaLibrary.js and VideoManager.js are not visible in the code review earlier but per test evidence render correctly; consider adding data-testid on the folder sidebar items and the file card action buttons (copy-url, delete) for future automated tests.
LearnChapter.js VideosPanel extractYtId returns null for shorts/live URLs (e.g., youtube.com/shorts/{id}). Add regex branch for /shorts/ and /live/.
